TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "欄位已確認在 shipments（carrier、shipped_ts、delivered_ts）。先抽樣檢查時間格式與物流商值，再決定計算方式。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts LIKE '2025-04%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-05%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-06%' LIMIT 20"}}

{"thought": "語意層沒有對應定義，我先以 shipments 的 shipped_ts 篩出 2025 年第二季，計算 delivered_ts 與 shipped_ts 的天數差，並檢查筆數、未送達與異常值。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'"}}

{"thought": "前一步的 SQL 結果已算出平均值，但尚未確認「配送天數」在語意層是否有特定定義（例如以哪個時間欄位為準、是否排除未送達或取消的訂單），因此先用 browse_semantics 搜尋相關規則。", "tool": "browse_semantics", "args": {"query": "配送 送達 出貨 天數 delivery shipment", "kind": "all", "limit": 6}}

response: {"thought": "語意層沒有「配送天數」的定義，我要確認 Q2 的出貨資料沒有同一訂單重複計算的情形，避免平均值被重複筆數影響。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_orders, SUM(cnt) AS rows_in_dup FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)"}}
